SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_no) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS revenue, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM `order` WHERE shop_id = #{param.searchField4} AND divide_status = 0 AND status = 1), 0) AS pendingAmount FROM `order` o INNER JOIN `product_order` po ON o.order_no = po.order_no WHERE o.shop_id = #{param.searchField4} AND po.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7)
AND o.create_time BETWEEN #{param.startTime} AND #{param.endTime}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `order` o INNER JOIN `product_order` po ON o.order_no = po.order_no WHERE po.status = 4
AND o.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT id, user_id as userId, phone, nick_name as nickName, shop_id as shopId, order_type as orderType, order_id as orderId, order_no as orderNo, up_order_no as upOrderNo, price, num, amount, status, pay_time as payTime, refund_amount as refundAmount, refund_time as refundTime, divide_amount as divideAmount, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM `order` WHERE order_type = 1 AND status IN (1, 2) AND ( (pay_time >= #{startTime} AND pay_time <= #{endTime}) OR (refund_time >= #{startTime} AND refund_time <= #{endTime}) ) ORDER BY id ASC
